verdict.rationale: As merchant of record, Paddle states it calculates, collects, and remits taxes on every sale across 200+ countries with no extra engineering, and its pricing pages show estimated taxes. Payout reconciliation reports itemize taxes, tax rates, and tax mode, and a community user confirms the EU VAT handling works. One user reported errors on a manually requested UK VAT invoice; that is a support and paperwork caveat rather than a concrete failure of automatic tax calculation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on calculation mechanics (tax-inclusive vs. exclusive pricing, B2B reverse charge and exemptions), and broader independent corroboration that the amounts are correct.
